title: The Quiet Courtyard
summary: A walled courtyard of cypress, olive and plane trees around a stone fountain, with the cove's shaded seats at its gate.
previewAlt: The Quiet Courtyard from above: a walled garden of cypress and olive trees around a fountain, with a canopied cove at its gate.

title: The Cove
summary: The workspace every new world starts from: a curved stone seat under a linen canopy, with a hearth, ferns and lamps.
previewAlt: The Cove: a curved stone seat with green cushions under a linen canopy on timber masts, ringed with potted ferns.

title: Tidemark Island
summary: A quiet tropical island with open beaches, layered jungle, a thatched shelter and gently moving wildlife.
previewAlt: Tidemark Island from above: a palm-dotted beach curving into turquoise shallows.
